title: CodeFlow Identity & Shared Vocabulary
$comment: Ticket 01 (contract foundation). Shared $defs referenced by all other contracts via absolute URL, e.g. {"$ref":"https://codeflow.local/schemas/identity.schema.json#/$defs/anchor"}.
description: Root document is an 'identity card' used by golden fixtures to exercise the shared vocabulary end-to-end. Producers embed the individual $defs in their own contracts; they do not emit this card. flowId derivation (normative): sha256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the canonicalEntrySymbolPath string, lowercase hex digest, first 16 hex chars, prefixed => 'flow-<16 hex>'. Move/rename stability: the id derives from the canonical entry symbol path, which survives file moves/renames because it is resolved through enclosingSymbolPath relink, not raw path. Collision rule (normative): if the derived flowId is already registered for a DIFFERENT canonical entry symbol path, append suffix '-2', '-3', ... '-N' until unique ('flow-<16hex>-2'); the registry keeps the mapping. stepId derivation: sha256 over UTF-8 bytes of '<flowId>#<ordinal>:<symbolPath>', first 16 hex chars, prefixed 'step-'; same collision suffix rule.

anchors.description: Fixture-only convenience: a sequence of anchors for the same logical location demonstrating move/rename + line-shift relink stability.

flowId.description: Stable flow identifier: 'flow-' + first 16 lowercase-hex chars of sha256(canonicalEntrySymbolPath UTF-8 bytes). Collision suffix '-2'..'-N' per registry rule. Stable under file move/rename because derivation keys on the canonical entry SYMBOL path, not the filesystem path.

candidateId.description: Ephemeral discovery candidate identifier: 'cand-' + first 16 lowercase-hex chars of sha256(canonicalEntrySymbolPath UTF-8 bytes).

stepId.description: 'step-' + first 16 lowercase-hex chars of sha256('<flowId>#<ordinal>:<symbolPath>' UTF-8 bytes). Same collision suffix rule as flowId.

canonicalEntrySymbolPath.description: Exact format (normative): '<repoRelativeSourceFilePath>#<TopLevelSymbol>(.<NestedMember>)*'. The left side is the repo-relative source file path with forward slashes and a language extension (e.g. .dart, .ts, .tsx, .kt, .swift, .py, .go, .java, .rs). The right side is the dotted chain from a top-level declaration down to the entry member. No whitespace anywhere; '#' separates exactly one file part from the symbol chain.

supersedes.description: Ordered list of predecessor flowIds this identity replaces (split/merge chains). A split emits one new flow whose supersedes lists the old root plus sibling branches; a merge emits one successor listing every absorbed branch. Chains must remain acyclic and terminate at flows with empty supersedes.

tombstone.description: Lifecycle tombstone. tombstoned=true means the flow no longer resolves at HEAD; supersededBy points at the successor flowId when the flow was renamed/split/merged, or null when the flow simply vanished without a successor. Tombstones keep historical event-ledger references resolvable (R9).

repoRelativePath.description: Repo-relative POSIX path, MUST NOT start with '/'. Never a line number.

byteRange.description: [startByte, endByte) half-open into the current file content; normative expectation start <= end (enforced by producers, cross-item inequality not expressible here).

fileHash.description: sha256 lowercase hex (64 chars) of the full file bytes.

spanHash.description: sha256 lowercase hex of exactly the bytes inside byteRange.

enclosingSymbolPath.description: Dotted symbol chain containing the span (e.g. 'EmailSignupNotifier.submit'). Invariant under pure line shifts.

canonicalAstFingerprint.description: sha256 lowercase hex of the canonical (whitespace/format-insensitive) serialization of the anchored AST node's behavior-bearing structure.

symbolRange.description: OPTIONAL presentation hint: [startByte, endByte) of the enclosing symbol (signature line through closing brace) enabling symbol-scoped code views. Never used for identity; freshness/relink ignore it. Producers SHOULD emit it; consumers MUST degrade gracefully when absent.

anchor.description: R3 anchor contract. Anchoring NEVER uses line numbers alone. Relink rule (normative): after code edits, re-resolve by matching enclosingSymbolPath AND canonicalAstFingerprint; on match, rewrite byteRange/fileHash/spanHash and the anchor stays linked (line-shift-only edits therefore never orphan an approval); on fingerprint mismatch the anchor is stale and goes to the approval queue; if enclosingSymbolPath no longer exists the anchor is orphaned.

provenance.description: Who produced a semantic value. Authority order: approved (E3 human approval) > session (E2 agent MCP submission) > derived (E1 deterministic identifier-rule transform) > unknown. E1 structural facts cannot be overwritten by E2/E3 regardless of provenance order.

freshness.description: Currentness of a value against the live worktree. fresh = anchor verified now; stale = anchor's canonicalAstFingerprint mismatches current code (structure cards remain, value goes to approval queue); orphaned = enclosingSymbolPath vanished. Independent of provenance.
